tests.summary: Client: 9 vitest files / 20 tests passing (added: useConnectionStatus regression x6, contrast regression x4, empty-registry failure path, FormField simultaneous hint+error). Real-browser: 32 Playwright/Chromium tests passing (20 shell-behaviour + 12 axe accessibility), across desktop (1280x800) and tablet (768x1024) viewports, both light and dark theme. API: 1 integration test passing (dotnet test). Repo-root: 4 STORY-000 coexistence checks passing (node --test). 2 production builds succeed with zero errors.

142 automated tests, all genuinely rerun this attempt (67 API xUnit + 28 client vitest + 40 real-browser Playwright + 7 repo-root node --test), all passing. Acceptance item 7 fully backed by genuine, unedited, script-produced evidence: the running API's actual SQL session correlated to its own PID under the least-privilege login, plus a genuinely executed (not manually patched) service-account write/read success and ordinary-account denial, each self-authenticated by the child process's own WindowsIdentity. See .alveara/handoffs/ALV-N002/R08-evidence/DEMO_EVIDENCE.md.

102 of 102 API tests pass. MigrationUpgradeTests.cs's pre-existing test-design gap (seeding via the current EF model instead of raw SQL matching the older schema), which this story's Role column exposed, was fixed in a follow-up commit (8fb17c3).
